import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_ran_beta_pdf(const double x, const double a, const double b);
gsl.gsl_ran_beta_pdf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_beta_pdf.restype = ctypes.c_double

def beta_pdf(x, a, b):
    """Compute the PDF of the Beta distribution using GSL."""
    if x < 0.0 or x > 1.0:
        return 0.0  # PDF is zero outside the valid range of x
    return gsl.gsl_ran_beta_pdf(x, a, b)

def assert_test():
    """Test cases for beta_pdf function."""
    # Test case 1: Valid input
    assert abs(beta_pdf(0.5, 2.0, 2.0) - 1.5) < 1e-6, "Test case 1 failed"
    
    # Test case 2: x out of bounds
    assert beta_pdf(-0.1, 2.0, 2.0) == 0.0, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert beta_pdf(1.1, 2.0, 2.0) == 0.0, "Test case 2 failed"
    
    # Test case 3: Edge case x = 1
    assert abs(beta_pdf(1.0, 2.0, 2.0) - 0.0) < 1e-6, "Test case 3 failed"

    # Test case 4: Edge case x = 0
    assert abs(beta_pdf(0.0, 2.0, 2.0) - 0.0) < 1e-6, "Test case 4 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
